cards.title: Today’s vocabulary
sections: A container made from thick paper, often used for milk or juice. We buy a carton of milk.
A piece of writing on an item that gives information about it. Read the label on the bottle.
an object such as a box or bottle used to hold things. Keep the food in a closed container.
A unit used for measuring the amount of a liquid. The bottle holds one liter of water.
A unit for measuring liquid; a US gallon is about 3.8 liters. We buy a gallon of milk.

articulation.label: bottle
articulation.alt: bottle: /b/ → /ɑ/ → /t/ → /ə/ → /l/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/ə/: Relax the tongue in the center.
/l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
